name: How long does a typical sliding door threshold repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sliding door threshold repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sliding door threshold repair depends on the severity and nature of the damage. Minor repairs, such as resealing or patching small cracks, might take a few hours. More extensive work, like replacing a rotted section or a full threshold, could take a full day or potentially longer if custom materials are needed or if there are unforeseen complications. A contractor can provide a time estimate after assessing the specific repair needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor issues to a full day or more for extensive damage or replacement, depending on severity.
